definitions.short: to hang up, i.e. weigh , or (figuratively) contemn
definitions.full: H5541. calah I. [ סָלָה ] verb make light of, toss aside (compare Assyrian salû, throw off , shake off (yoke) Dl 500 ; Arabic , is be forgetful, neglectful Lane 1417 ; Aramaic סְלָא despise , reject ); — Qal Perfect 2masculine singular סָלִיתָ Psa 119:118 thou dost make light of all those that err from thy statutes. — compare also סַלּוֺן below Pi`el intensive Perfect 3masculine singular סִלָּה Lam 1:15 Adonay hath flouted at my mighty ones. II. [ סָלָה ] verb weigh, balance (|| form of סָלָא q.v); — Pu`al Imperfect 3feminine singular בְּכֶתֶם לֹאתְֿסֻלֶּה Job 28:16 it cannot be weighed against (estimated in) gold of Ophir, compare 28:19 . סֶ֫לָה see סלל below
